title: Compliance audit pack generation with regional residency filters and scheduled delivery
creator: Aisha Menon
description: Deliver a first-class capability to produce compliance 'audit packs' (PDF and CSV) scoped by tenant, region, and retention policy. Packs should combine evidence (audit logs, access history, export manifests), configuration snapshots (data residency + retention settings), and summarized metrics (counts, sizes, and delivery status). Support scheduled generation (cron-like rules), on-demand bundles, and configurable delivery channels (S3/SFTP/email/webhook). Ensure all exports honor tenant data residency and retention rules, are encrypted at rest/in-transit, and produce tamper-evident manifests and an auditable delivery trail.
acceptance_criteria: Admin can create a scheduled audit pack job that scopes exports by tenant ID, region tag (us-east-1, eu-west-1, ap-southeast-1), and retention window (e.g., last 90 days)

Generated packs include: (a) CSV of raw events matching the scope, (b) human-readable PDF summary with key metrics and policy snapshots, (c) a JSON manifest listing files, record counts, and checksums
Exports are produced in the region(s) where the scoped data resides. If target delivery channel is cross-region, the system prompts for an explicit authorization and logs the decision
Export files are encrypted using tenant KMS keys; keys are not exported. Delivery channel supports S3 (with bucket in permitted region), SFTP, email (small summary only), and webhook (signed)
Delivery status and proof (transfer logs, checksums, timestamps) are recorded in the Console under a new 'Compliance Exports' dashboard and available via API
Admins can request immediate on-demand packs and cancel scheduled jobs; cancelation prevents any pending delivery and records audit entry
System enforces retention rules: exported data respects retention masking/omission for records that must be redacted or excluded per tenant policy
End-to-end tests validate correctness for at least two tenants with different residency and retention policies and demonstrate SFTP and S3 delivery paths
technical_notes: Implement an export orchestration service that composes export tasks: query engine -> formatter (CSV/PDF) -> encryptor -> delivery adapter
Leverage existing KV cache and query slicing for efficient event extraction; ensure queries stream to avoid memory spikes on large windows
Use tenant-scoped KMS envelope keys; require security sign-off for any design that exports keys or cross-region plaintext
PDF summary will be generated from a templates service; include a signed manifest (SHA256) embedded in the PDF metadata
Add rate limits and backoff on delivery adapters; SFTP adapter must support passive/active modes and resume on transient failures

New database table: compliance_export_jobs (id, tenant, region_scope, schedule_cron, last_run_time, status, delivery_target, manifest_uri) - simple schema only, keep as strings to match linear doc constraints
rollout_plan: MVP (internal): implement CSV + JSON manifest, S3 delivery, basic scheduling; expose API and Console view in a restricted beta
Beta (customer opt-in): add PDF summaries, SFTP adapter, email notifications, regional enforcement checks; invite three pilot customers from EU and NA
GA: add webhook delivery, cancellation flows in Console, full observability and RBAC entries, docs and runbook
Post-GA: enhance with per-file signing, compression options, and retention-aware diff exports
dependencies: ENG-4921 (KMS multi-tenant key management, blocking for encryption-at-rest)
ENG-5060 (Streaming query improvements for large historical windows)
ENG-4789 (Delivery adapters: S3/SFTP libs and retry framework)
PM-5221 (Compliance export orchestration tenant-aware reporting) - informational overlap
